case_number: 2025 INSC 153; CRIMINAL APPEAL No. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Criminal) No. 1953/2024)
summary: Bail granted by High Court in NDPS Act case set aside due to accused's arrest in subsequent similar offence; recovery classified as intermediate, not commercial, but public interest and repeat involvement justify custody; Trial Court directed to expedite trial within four months; appeal allowed on grounds of changed circumstances post-bail.
final_judgment: Impugned bail order set aside; respondent directed to be taken into custody; trial to be concluded within four months.
